name: @usdk/driver-vision
description: A labeled, honest capability-vision stub - isAvailable() returns false and describe() always rejects, because no offline vision model was confirmed available in this environment (see docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md). This is NOT a fixture that pretends to describe images; it is an explicit 'this capability could not be wired up' marker, so a host can show a clear message instead of silently doing nothing.
